intro: In Dubai's fast-paced high-rise and infrastructure construction sector, a tower crane is the central heartbeat of the job site. When a tower crane stops, structural concrete pours halt, steel reinforcement lifting ceases, and hundreds of workers are left idling. Ensuring an uninterrupted, stable electricity supply to the crane's hoisting, slewing, and trolley motors is paramount to meeting strict project completion deadlines.

Before permanent DEWA or utility grid power is connected to a site—or where grid connections experience voltage sags and capacity constraints—a dedicated [100 kVA commercial diesel generator](https://www.energexequip.ae/en/products/100-kva-commercial-diesel-generator) is the industry standard power solution. It provides the exact balance of active electrical output (80 kW), high motor-starting surge capacity, and responsive governor control needed to handle the dynamic shock loads of heavy lifting.

Energex Equipment Rental delivers turnkey 100 kVA generator packages specifically configured for modern tower cranes equipped with Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and electronic control systems across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and all seven Emirates.

faqs.question: Why is a 100 kVA generator the recommended size for most construction tower cranes?
faqs.answer: A standard construction tower crane typically features a main hoisting motor between 30 kW and 45 kW, along with slewing motors (5–11 kW) and trolley motors (3–5 kW). While total running power rarely exceeds 55–65 kW, the initial starting surge—even with soft starters or VFD drives—requires instantaneous peak capacity. A 100 kVA (80 kW) generator provides sufficient reserve headroom to start heavy lifts smoothly without causing voltage drops that could trigger drive fault codes.

faqs.question: Can your 100 kVA generators safely power cranes with Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)?
faqs.answer: Yes. Modern tower cranes rely heavily on VFDs to achieve smooth acceleration and deceleration. Cheap or undersized generators with sluggish mechanical governors produce harmonic distortion and voltage fluctuations that cause crane inverters to trip out. Energex 100 kVA units are fitted with advanced electronic governors and digital AVRs with PMG excitation, delivering clean, stable sine-wave power that keeps VFD drives operating reliably.

faqs.question: What happens if our tower crane needs to operate 24 hours a day during continuous concrete pouring?
faqs.answer: Our 100 kVA generators are prime-rated for continuous 24/7 operation. For long continuous shifts such as foundation raft pours or slipforming, we provide external bunded fuel storage tanks connected via three-way valves and schedule routine maintenance outside of critical hoisting hours to ensure zero work interruption.

faqs.question: How fast can Energex mobilize and connect a 100 kVA generator to our site in Dubai or Abu Dhabi?
faqs.answer: We maintain active stock of pre-tested 100 kVA soundproof generators at our Dubai and UAE distribution hubs. For urgent requirements, we can dispatch, deliver, position, cable, and commission the generator on your construction site within hours.

faqs.question: Does Energex supply the required electrical cables and distribution boards for the crane?
faqs.answer: Yes. We supply heavy-duty 4-core armored copper power cables sized specifically for the distance between the generator and the crane base switchboard, complete with industrial plugs, circuit breakers, and certified site grounding rods.

faqs.question: Can the 100 kVA generator also power site lighting or a passenger hoist at the same time?
faqs.answer: Depending on the crane's hoist motor capacity and operating cycle, a 100 kVA generator may have spare capacity to power essential mast lighting or a small passenger hoist during light crane lifting. However, for large Alimak passenger hoists running simultaneously with the main crane, we recommend either dedicated separate units or stepping up to our [250 kVA industrial generator](https://www.energexequip.ae/en/products/250-kva-industrial-power-generator) to prevent overloading.

intro: Traditional diesel generators running 24/7 on low or fluctuating loads suffer from extreme fuel inefficiency, engine wet-stacking, high maintenance costs, and persistent carbon emissions. In noise-sensitive urban communities and environmentally conscious projects across the UAE, continuous generator noise during the night is increasingly restricted.

Energex Hybrid Power Systems combine high-capacity lithium-ion Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) with efficient soundproof diesel generators. During low-load periods—such as night shifts, security lighting, and cabin power—the generator automatically shuts down, allowing the silent battery pack to supply 100% of the site's electricity with zero noise and zero emissions.

When high motor loads or heavy equipment switch on, the intelligent controller restarts the diesel generator, running it at its optimal efficiency curve to power the site while simultaneously recharging the battery bank.

Energex Fuel Management Services takes complete ownership of your site's diesel logistics. We deploy double-walled, bunded fuel storage tanks (1,000L to 10,000L capacities) equipped with smart IoT ultrasonic telemetry sensors that transmit real-time fuel levels, burn rates, and refill alerts directly to our central dispatch center.

Our dedicated fleet of specialized fuel tankers operates 24/7 across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the Northern Emirates, delivering premium diesel directly to your generators and storage tanks before fuel levels ever reach a critical threshold.

faqs.question: How do you monitor generator fuel levels remotely?
faqs.answer: We install ultrasonic IoT telemetry sensors on all external bulk tanks and generator base tanks. These sensors transmit real-time fuel volume and burn rates to our cloud platform, automatically alerting dispatchers when levels reach the reorder point.

faqs.question: Are your fuel storage tanks environmentally compliant in the UAE?
faqs.answer: Yes. All our bulk fuel tanks are double-walled with 110% bunded containment capacity, fully preventing environmental leaks and conforming to UAE Civil Defense and municipal safety regulations.

faqs.question: Can you supply fuel to existing generators that we already own?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide complete fuel logistics and bulk tank rental services for third-party client equipment as well as our own rental fleet.

intro: Construction projects in Dubai and across the UAE operate on aggressive deadlines where work cannot afford to wait for permanent municipal grid connections. From the initial soil breaking and dewatering phases to structural concrete pouring and final MEP fit-outs, independent temporary power is essential at every milestone.

Energex specializes in comprehensive construction site electrification. We deliver rugged, soundproof diesel generators engineered specifically for dusty, high-temperature construction environments, equipped with heavy-duty alternators capable of absorbing the extreme motor-starting currents of tower cranes, hoists, batching plants, and submersible pumps.

Our construction packages include everything contractors need for immediate operational readiness: site distribution boards (DBs), certified armored cables, weather-tight socket boxes, emergency standby replacement units, and scheduled 24/7 on-site maintenance.

faqs.question: What size generator do I need for my construction site?
faqs.answer: Generator sizing depends on your equipment list: site offices usually need 30-50 kVA, tower cranes require 100 kVA, while concrete batching plants or multi-crane high-rises need 250 kVA to 1000 kVA. Our engineers provide free on-site load calculations.

faqs.question: Can the generator handle the dust and heat of a Dubai construction site?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our generators feature dual-stage desert sand pre-filters, tropicalized radiators rated for 50°C, and IP55 enclosures specifically engineered for dusty UAE construction environments.

faqs.question: Do you provide power distribution boards and cables?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide complete site electrification packages, including armored copper cables, multi-socket distribution boards (DBs), and earth grounding.
